create_dense_linearization: create a DenseLinearization instance from an Objective with optional VariableOrdering
linearize_jacobian_dense: build the dense Jacobian matrix A and residual vector b from cost functions
linearize_hessian_dense: compute the Hessian approximation AtA and Atb from the dense Jacobian
get_hessian_approx: retrieve the precomputed Hessian approximation matrix AtA from DenseLinearization
compute_Av_product: compute the matrix-vector product of Jacobian A with vector v using bmm
